blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The country’s railway projects could require up to 20,000 personnel, according to the Department of Transportation (DOTr), which has trained nearly 5,000 railway workers through the Philippine Railways Institute (PRI) since its establishment in 2019. The institute provides training in railway safety, operations and maintenance as the government develops major projects, including the Metro Manila Subway, MRT-7 and the North-South Commuter Railway (NSCR). Transportation Secretary Banoy Lopez said the training helps prepare workers to operate and maintain the country’s expanding rail network. “Training railway employees at PRI is a big help because it makes them more professional and […]...
